newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper seen opening slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper seen opening slightly higher.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly higher Monday, with LME copper steady in London, though a further test of the downside eventually is not ruled out, traders said.

Both COMEX copper and LME copper prices have swung in a wide range in the past ten days, partly on options related trade as short positions, established during the Sumitomo affair earlier this year, were unwound.
COMEX December copper was seen opening up 0.30 to 0.50 cent from Friday's close of 89.80 cents a lb, with the September/December backwardation continuing to narrow.
COMEX December copper traded between 89.85 and 90.45 cents on overnight ACCESS.
COMEX warehouse stocks slipped 501 short tons to 22,603 short tons Friday.
